item.title: Designing a Distributed API Rate Limiter Across Multiple Gateways
item.description: A peer-to-peer technical design discussion co-creating a robust distributed API rate limiter. The conversation evaluates strong candidate algorithms, their trade-offs, failure modes, observability, and failure handling to balance burst tolerance, fairness, latency, and operational simplicity in a multi-gateway environment with an external Redis backing store.
